title: Project Blue Beam conspiracy theory
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Project Blue Beam conspiracy theory, about an unknown time at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So, there's this conspiracy theory called Project Blue Beam.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, brings up an idea called Project Blue Beam while interviewing Jake Barber, a man who says he helped retrieve a UFO with his helicopter. Michels himself calls it a conspiracy theory, but in the episode he gives no details about what it claims.
